evidence.reason: The post-command authority validation at lines 519-521 runs after the terminal Git child has exited. A successful `update-ref` can therefore already have created the evidence ref when that validation rejects; `terminalGit` throws, so the caller never reaches the code that sets `attempt.retained`, and the lifecycle omits the existing ref from the report. Recording the confirmed ref before this post-command check is a narrow correctness repair and preserves the authority guard before any further restoration or writes.
